title.original: Multi-Agent Coordination Adaptation via Structure-Guided Orchestration
title.zh: 通过结构引导式编排实现多智能体协调自适应
title.en: Multi-Agent Coordination Adaptation via Structure-Guided Orchestration

inclusion_reason.zh: MACA 的条件结构先验与策略编排联合控制参与关系和调用预算，是通用多 Agent 协调运行机制。
inclusion_reason.en: MACA's conditional structural prior and policy orchestration jointly control participation and call budgets as a general multi-agent coordination runtime.

abstract.zh: MACA 将多 Agent 协调视为结构与编排的联合后验推断，以任务和预算条件化的结构先验约束动态策略。
abstract.en: MACA casts multi-agent coordination as joint posterior inference over structure and orchestration, using task- and budget-conditioned structural priors to guide a dynamic policy.

problem.zh: 预先固定结构稳定但缺少细粒度适应，纯动态编排灵活却使交互结构隐式、波动且容易产生冗余。
problem.en: Precommitted structures are stable but inflexible, whereas purely dynamic orchestration is adaptive but leaves interaction structure implicit, unstable, and redundant.

approach.zh: 框架学习哪些 Agent 参与及如何连接的条件先验，再由策略编排器近似后验，根据运行状态在先验范围内细调调用。
approach.en: The framework learns a conditional prior over participation and links, then a policy orchestrator approximates posterior inference and adjusts calls from execution state.

system_design.zh: 结构模块根据任务与 token 预算输出候选协作图，策略模块在图上选择下一交互，反馈模块联合更新结构和执行决策。
system_design.en: A structure module proposes a collaboration graph from task and token budget, a policy selects interactions on it, and feedback jointly adapts structure and execution.

key_results.zh: 联合适应在多个基准上以更少 token 超过动态多 Agent 基线，并通过压制重复交互收敛到任务有效结构。
key_results.en: Joint adaptation outperforms dynamic multi-agent baselines with fewer tokens and converges toward task-effective structures by suppressing redundant interactions.

limitations.zh: 学习到的结构先验可能在新任务或新 Agent 集合上失配，后验近似仍依赖中心化状态和可获得的预算信号。
limitations.en: The learned structural prior may misfit new tasks or agent populations, and posterior approximation still depends on centralized state and observable budget signals.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
